description: sales-advantage: internal sales-coaching app for the Reading Advantage sales team and distributor reps. Audio roleplay practice — learner records themselves in a sales scenario (cold call, discovery, demo, objection, close), an OpenRouter-hosted multimodal model evaluates the audio directly (single-pass, no separate transcription) against a rubric grounded in advantage-pr/09-sales-enablement. Primary model nvidia/nemotron-3-nano-omni-30b-a3b-reasoning:free (free, audio→text reasoning), fallback google/gemini-2.5-flash-lite, both via OpenRouter. Linear curriculum (no Mastery Advantage KST/SRS engine in v1), LLM-generated then human-reviewed, sourced from the existing battle cards, demo scripts, objection guide, ROI calculator, and distributor rep onboarding pack.
